headlines.title: Strategy (MSTR) Moved 3,568 BTC In Hours And Investors Want Answers
headlines.summary: Strategy (NasdaqGS:MSTR) shifted 3,568 BTC, worth nearly US$300 million, out of its wallets within several hours. The rapid transfer involved a concentrated move rather than small routine transactions, according to wallet activity tracked on-chain. The size of the shift represents a meaningful slice of Strategy's corporate Bitcoin holdings, which anchor its treasury profile.

headlines.title: Michael Saylor Wants His Bitcoin Rival to Win: What's in It for MicroStrategy?
headlines.summary: Michael Saylor says he wants Bitcoin rival Strive to succeed. Here's what Strategy gains, and where the pitch gets harder.

headlines.title: How Daily Dividends Could Shake Up the MicroStrategy Stock Story
headlines.summary: Strategy wants its preferred stocks to pay dividends every single day. Here's how the plan works and what it could mean for MSTR stock investors.

headlines.title: Can Strategy (MSTR) Be A Bargain Based On Book Value?
headlines.summary: Strategy has ridden a powerful Bitcoin story and now trades around US$158.61, which puts fresh attention on a much quieter anchor of valuation: its book value. After such a crypto driven run, the question for you is whether the balance sheet behind the stock still supports today’s market price. Over the past 3 years the share price has gained about 381.4%, which makes it important to test how much of that move is backed by the company’s underlying net assets.

headlines.title: Michael Saylor's Strategy just bought more Bitcoin, this purchase was 75% bigger
headlines.summary: Strategy’s holdings reach 847,666 BTC as the firm also repurchases $152 million of its STRC preferred stock.

description: Strategy Inc, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a bitcoin treasury company in the United States, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and internationally. It offers investors varying degrees of economic exposure to Bitcoin by offering a range of securities, including equity and fixed income instruments. The company also provides AI-powered enterprise analytics software, including Strategy One, which provides non-technical users with the ability to directly access novel and actionable insights for decision-making. In addition, the company provides Strategy Mosaic, a universal intelligence layer that offers enterprises with consistent definitions and governance across data sources, regardless of where that data resides or which tools access it. The company was formerly known as MicroStrategy Incorporated and changed its name to Strategy Inc in August 2025. The company was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Tysons Corner, Virginia.
